_comment: DERIVED VIEW, HAND-MIRRORED -- there is no generator. Canonical source is DECLARED_TRANSITIONS in plugins/soleur/lib/workflow-fidelity.ts; this file is a byte-for-byte mirror of DECLARED_TRANSITIONS and DECLARED_SUB_STEPS, and the ONLY thing keeping it honest is the `declared-transitions derived view parity` block in plugins/soleur/test/workflow-fidelity.test.ts. It has ONE consumer: the offline transition classifier (scripts/classify-workflow-transitions.sh, bash). (The byte ratchet read it too until the review simplification pass; its row set is now the ceiling file itself, pinned in TS.) A `bun -e` read of the const was weighed at review and not taken -- see ADR-229 Alternatives -- so this mirror stays, while the const cannot be replaced by this file: the plugin ships as ./plugins/soleur and does not carry .claude/, so a runtime read returns nothing on a customer install. Kept OUT of .claude/phase-surface-map.json deliberately -- that file is deep-equal to the bundled web copy (apps/web-platform/test/phase-surface-map-parity.test.ts), so a key added there would push FSM edges through the web bundle, which has no consumer for them. To change an edge: edit DECLARED_TRANSITIONS, mirror the same change here, then run `bun test plugins/soleur/test/workflow-fidelity.test.ts` (parity fails in both directions) (a new node also needs a ceiling row in plugins/soleur/test/skill-body-budget.json; the same suite pins that). `sub_steps` mirrors `DECLARED_SUB_STEPS` (same parity block, same edit-TS-first rule; the entry rules are listed on the TS const); the classifier drops a sub-step record before pairing and reports the count as `substep=`. See ADR-229 (amended 2026-09-19, #8325).
